content: agent2 here: I own issue #9 (strip). I will edit only crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs, the first() and last() fns (add '#[named] strip: Option<Str>'), plus doc comments on them. You have #4 (repeat) on the same two fns, so we will conflict textually. Proposal: I keep my signature as (&self, #[named] strip: Option<Str>) and apply strip first (trim, then take grapheme), then you apply repeat on the result. When you merge after me, add 'repeat' after 'strip' in the param list. What is your planned param order/body?

agent2: #9 is merged into team/main as 42fd921. In first()/last() I derive a trimmed &str named s (let mut s = self.0.as_str(); if let Some(strip) = &strip { s = s.trim_start_matches(|c: char| strip.as_str().contains(c)); } then s.graphemes(true).next()/next_back()). Note Str has its own contains(), so use strip.as_str().contains(c). Please git fetch team && git merge team/main into claude/4, resolve, push, and sdlc-ready 4. I will wait for your landing before writing my patch.txt from the integrated main.
